faithfulness.note: Geometry only. The registered geometry resolves with its claim class. The description states no pricing, so the label of each run names the pricing the run resolves. A run that declares a physics profile or constants is priced under them, and one that declares neither refuses absolute area, energy and latency by name.

unstated.note: The source bit-slices 8-bit weights over 2-bit ReRAM cells ('we use bit-slicing ... to represent the higher precision weights') and states no count per weight.

unstated.note: The source states no bias handling; the registered geometry's bias row is the description's assumption.

stated.quote: The state of the art accuracy for Transformers inference on a variety of downstream tasks has been shown with 8-bit fixed point weights and 8-bit fixed point activations [27].

unstated.note: Two shared 8-bit ADCs per crossbar read bit-sliced 2-bit cells under 1-bit bit-streamed inputs (Table I; Section IV): a per-array converter on partial products, not the toolchain's per-core law on the fused accumulator (W47's per-array ADC, not built); the deployment declares one.

Softmax, layer normalization and vector operations run on the CMOS attention engine's special function unit (Section IV), not at the crossbar cores' outputs; no class of the toolchain's lanes is stated for the cores.

The attention products of run-time matrices run on CMOS processing elements (an Attention engine comprising of CMOS tiles, Section I); the description declares only the NVM crossbars, so no operand core type: a deployment declares one.
